title: AI Smart Glasses – 8MP Camera & Voice Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Step into the future with your glasses

Taking out your phone to film or look something up always interrupts the moment. Sometimes you just want to capture the moment right away.

Camera, sound and AI in one pair of glasses

These smart glasses have a built-in 8MP camera, open-ear audio and an AI voice assistant. You can record 1080p video, listen to music and let the AI recognize objects – without taking out your phone.

Features

  • Built-in 8MP camera
  • 1080p HD video recording
  • Open-ear audio for music and calls
  • AI voice assistant with object recognition
  • Stylish design like regular sunglasses

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
